subject: Maths
title: Ordering FDP
subtitle: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can order fractions, decimals and percentages by converting to a common form.

key_vocab.definition: Ordering FDP means arranging fractions, decimals and percentages from SMALLEST to largest (ascending) or largest to smallest (descending).

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can order fractions, decimals and percentages by converting to a common form.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Ordering FDP -- Ordering FDP means arranging fractions, decimals and percentages from SMALLEST to largest (ascending) or largest to smallest (descending).

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Convert everything to decimals. Compare digit by digit from left to right. Write your final answer in the ORIGINAL forms given in the question.
30%, ⅜, 0.34 → 0.30, 0.375, 0.34
Ascending: 30%, 0.34, ⅜

Key examples:
  ✓ ½, 0.6, 55% → 0.5, 0.6, 0.55  (convert to decimals)
  ✓ Order: 0.5, 0.55, 0.6  (ascending)
  ✓ Answer: ½, 55%, 0.6  (rewrite in original form)
  ✗ ⅓ > ¼ because 3 < 4  (wrong reasoning)
  ✗ 0.9  9  (ignoring place value)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – two values
  Which is larger: ⅗ or 55%?
  ⅗ = 3 ÷ 5 = 0.6
  55% = 0.55
  0.6 > 0.55
  ⅗ is larger
  (Convert both to decimals: 0.6 > 0.55, so ⅗ is larger.)

Example 2 – three values ascending
  Order: 0.7, ¾, 72%
  0.7, 0.75, 0.72
  Smallest first: 0.7
  0.7, 72%, ¾
  0.7, 72%, ¾
  (All as decimals: 0.7, 0.75, 0.72. Ascending: 0.7, 0.72, 0.75.)

sections.title: Convert to decimals
sections.content:
Convert each value to a decimal so you can compare them.

(a) ⅖ = ___
(b) 65% = ___
(c) ⅞ = ___
(d) 4% = ___

sections.title: Compare two values
sections.content:
Write  between each pair. Convert to decimals first.

(a) ½ ___ 45%
(b) 0.3 ___ ¼
(c) 68% ___ &frac{7}{10}
(d) ⅝ ___ 60%

sections.title: Order ascending (smallest first)
sections.content:
Write these in ascending order. Show your decimal conversions.

(a) 0.4, ½, 35%
(b) 62%, ⅗, 0.58
(c) &frac{3}{8}, 40%, 0.39
(d) 0.15, 12%, ⅛

sections.title: Order descending (largest first)
sections.content:
Write these in descending order. Show your decimal conversions.

(a) 0.8, 75%, ⅘
(b) &frac{9}{10}, 88%, 0.92
(c) 55%, 0.6, &frac{11}{20}
(d) &frac{7}{8}, 90%, 0.86
